The Darkside Detective: Backside of the Moon - Official Game Trailer | Cozy After Dark Showcase 2026
Check out the Gameplay Trailer for The Darkside Detective: Backside of the Moon, a 2D point-and-click adventure game developed by Spooky Doorway. Players will take on six unsettling mysteries as Detective McQueen and Officer Dooley, who are primed and ready to solve each case one at a time. The Darkside Detective: Backside of the Moon is coming soon to PC (Steam).

Tom the Postgirl - Official Release Date Trailer | Cozy After Dark Showcase 2026
Get a look at the Release Date Trailer for Tom the Postgirl, a hand-drawn dark fantasy game developed by Oopsie Daisies and ARTE France. Players will embody Tom making her delivery rounds to peculiar residents across town. Tom the Postgirl is launching on October 29 for Nintendo Switch and PC (Steam).

text:
Gretel & Hansel - Official Trailer | Cozy After Dark Showcase 2026
Gretel & Hansel is a fully hand-painted watercolor horror-adventure in which Gretel must guide her brother through a cursed forest, outwit deadly traps, solve sinister puzzles, and escape a ravenous witch. Originally released in 2009 and 2010, Gretel & Hansel has been fully reimagined and expanded with Part 3. Gretel & Hansel will be available on PC.

Draftula - Official Trailer | Cozy After Dark Showcase 2026
Build up your castle in this roguelike twist on the block-dropping puzzler! Place your rooms strategically to reach greater heights. Will you be able to build a fortress to stand the test of time, or will that pesky hero send your work crumbling to the ground? Check out the latest Draftula trailer. Draftula will be available on PC. A demo is out now on Steam.

text:
"He Looks Like John Cena!" | David Dastmalchian Explains His Approach to Street Fighter's M. Bison
Watch the full interview: https://youtu.be/bFcsh7RLtOg

With his imposing frame, M. Bison is one of the most iconic video game villains ever. David Dastmalchian explains how he went about embodying the leader of Shadaloo, despite thinking at first director Kitao Sakurai would be looking for a pro wrestler-type for the role.

Watch the Reveal Trailer for The Takeover 2, an action beat 'em up arcade game developed by Pelikan13. Players will take to the streets once more to dispatch enemies in an action-packed fashion. The Takeover 2 is coming soon to PC (Steam).

Check out the Game Trailer for Toxic Crusaders, a side-scrolling arcade action beat 'em up game developed by Retroware. Players will fight on the streets with seven playable characters in pixel-art madness. Toxic Crusaders is coming soon to PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam).

Don't miss the Gameplay Trailer for Nyra and the Garden of Moros, a third-person exploration adventure game developed by Resting Relic. Players will explore a melancholic open world to retrieve the seals of the Keepers and stop the corruption from spreading further. Nyra and the Garden of Moros is coming soon to PC (Steam).

Nivalis Nights - Official Gameplay Launch Trailer | The MIX Fall Game Showcase 2026
Watch the Gameplay Launch Trailer for Nivalis Nights, a cyberpunk life management game developed by Ion Lands. Players will design societies to their exact specification with establishing apartments, growing businesses, and managing a cyberpunk city. Nivalis Nights is available now on PC (Steam).

Cresata - Official Trailer | The MIX Fall Game Showcase 2026
Meet the voice actors of Cresata (including Aleks Le and Ben Starr) and watch them perform lines in this new trailer for Cresata, an upcoming action platformer game. The new trailer also showcases gameplay, its world, and what to expect. Cresata will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, Steam, and Epic Games Store.

Coral Island - Official Update and Switch 2 Announce Trailer | The MIX Fall Game Showcase 2026
Coral Island gets a new trailer announcing a new update and a Nintendo Switch 2 reveal. Watch the latest Coral Island trailer to learn more about gameplay, what to expect from the farm sim, Nintendo Switch 2 features, and the new Kids Grow-Up 1.4 update. Coral Island is available now on PC (Steam), Windows PC, Xbox Series X/S, and PlayStation 5 (PS5). The Kids Grow-Up update will be available in winter 2026, alongside its launch on Nintendo Switch 2.

text:
Abelina - Official Demo Announce Trailer | The MIX Fall Game Showcase 2026
Take a look at the trailer for Abelina, an upcoming surreal, hand-crafted adventure platformer game. You died and woke up here in Abelina. Now you're heading out into the frontier with your companions following behind. There is no combat, instead you explore a vast world and a mature story about carrying life's baggage into the afterlife. Abelina will be available on PC. A demo will be out on Steam this November 2026.
